in_hebrew.name: Eusebio
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Eusebio הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek name Eusebios meaning 'well-served' or 'good news'. It was a common name in the Roman Empire, especially for those who were devoted to Christianity. In the Bible, Eusebio is not mentioned directly, but there is a Saint Eusebius of Caesarea who was a prominent early Christian scholar and theologian, and a Bishop of Caesarea in Palestine.

in_latin.name: Eusebius
in_latin.meaning: Blessed, well-spoken, devout, pious, godly, righteous
in_latin.long_meaning: Eusebius, from Greek Εὐσεβίων (Eusēbiōn), derived from εὐσεβής (eusebēs), meaning 'well-pleasing to the gods, virtuous, pious, devout'. In early Christian tradition, Eusebius was a name bestowed upon Christians who exhibited exemplary piety and devotion to God. The name Eusebius is mentioned in the writings of early Christian fathers, including Eusebius of Caesarea, a prominent historian and theologian of the 4th century. Eusebius is associated with the qualities of righteousness, kindness, and compassion, making it a revered name in Christian tradition.
